scoring_rule: decisions/0009: penalty 30 Critical, 12 High, 4 Medium, 1 Low; ceiling 40 with a Critical, 70 with a High, else 100; score = min(100 - penalty, ceiling), not below 0; Requirements is its own part; project = weakest checked part.

findings.title: The Pixel Office server and hook run on Node 22.21.1, which is five security releases behind; known node:http fixes are missing in the server that works now
findings.where: tools/package.json:8 (engines "node": ">=22 <23" lets any vulnerable 22.x pass); tools/src/pixel-office/server.js:467 (http.createServer) and :504 (listen); tools/src/pixel-office/hook.sh:30-45 (the hook takes node 22 from PATH or the Homebrew node@22 folder)
findings.check: Node version: the Node that actually runs the Pixel Office server and hook, against the Node 22 security releases (WF-05 rule for vulnerable dependencies)
findings.item: Q10 (realistic failures do not bring the system down) through the WF-05 rule for vulnerable dependencies; Q12 (decisions/0002: Node 22)

recheck.how: `node -v` and `which -a node`; `ps` and `lsof` of the running Pixel Office server (read only); nodejs.org/dist/index.json and the Node 22 changelog fetched; a separate Pixel Office server started from the project code on port 0 with a temporary state folder outside the project, raw HTTP requests with 1 990, 2 500 and 3 000 short headers (`a:1`), the Host header first or last; `grep` of maxHeadersCount, headersDistinct, trailersDistinct, AsyncLocalStorage, async_hooks over tools/src
recheck.seen: node v22.21.1 (Homebrew node@22); the working server `node src/pixel-office/main.js --port 4790` (started 2026-10-18) runs the binary node@22/22.21.1_4 and listens on localhost:4790. Security releases after 22.21.1: 22.22.0, 22.22.2, 22.23.0, 22.23.2, 22.23.4 (security=true). Reachable now: the fix CVE-2026-58044 «http: reject requests exceeding max header count» (22.23.2, rated Low by Node) — the separate server on 22.21.1 accepted a request with 2 500 headers (above the default limit of 2 000) with `200 OK` instead of refusing it, and with Host as header 2 501 it answered `400` (the headers after the 2 000th are silently dropped); the server stayed up (a later GET 200). Not reachable: CVE-2026-21710 (headersDistinct/trailersDistinct are never read in tools/src — the getter is not called) and CVE-2025-59466 (no async_hooks or AsyncLocalStorage in tools/src). So the vulnerable http code is reachable in what works now, but only from a program on this computer (the server listens on the loopback address), and the observed effect is a refused request, not a crash. By the WF-05 scale (a known vulnerability reachable in the Pixel Office server) the severity stays Critical.

findings.note: One cause with DEP-02: the local Node build 22.21.1 and the open engines floor «>=22 <23». The CI (check.yml, node-version 22) takes the newest 22.x and is not affected.
